newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates down.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates down.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell to a range of 10 and 10-1/2 percent in a liquid private sector market on Wednesday from 10-1/2 to 11 percent on Tuesday, bankers said.
One week rates also went down to between 10 and 10-1/4 percent from 10-1/2 to 10-3/4 percent.
Many bankers, however, said they did not make any deals due to the liquidity.
"We are quite liquid,"one banker said. He attributed this to cash inflows.
Others said the market was liquid after the Central Bank's 500 million pound repo on Tuesday.
"The central bank has likely accepted all applications," one banker said.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
